assessments.reasoning: I reopened the retained original IBM reference. Its title and edition notice identify Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 and the June 28, 2024 update. The preface supplies the relationship the title alone cannot establish. IBM describes how it implements COBOL and includes its own additions to the language.

challenge.method: Could the product name alone have been mistaken for evidence of implementation or standards conformance?
challenge.results: The preface expressly supplies the implementation relationship. It makes no edition-specific conformance finding.

limitations: This direction links the independent COBOL language to one publisher-documented implementation. It conveys no claim of conformance to any exact COBOL standard edition, completeness, current support, or identical semantics.
